Who we work with

Each report is written for the person who needs to act on it, with findings, photos and recommended next steps.

Property managers

Condition records, defect reports and contractor coordination that keep your maintenance planning on track.

Property owners

An independent view of your building’s condition, so you can budget for repairs before they become failures.

Contractors

Pre- and post-works records and roof surveys that support accurate pricing and protect you from disputes.

Services

Commercial and residential inspections, with drone imaging for roofs and areas that are unsafe or impractical to access.

Drone roof surveys

A drone-based survey of the full roof, with a detailed report included.

CASA-compliant drone operations. RPA and drone accreditation details are available on request.

  • Roof condition report
  • High-resolution aerial imagery
  • Drainage and box gutter assessment
  • Flashing and penetration inspection
  • Visible roof defects
  • Plant and equipment overview
  • Solar currently in place
  • Access points
  • Fall arrest and Mansafe systems
  • Assessment of inaccessible areas

Dilapidation reports

Condition records of sites and assets before and after works.

  • Pre-works dilapidation report
  • Post-works reporting
  • Photographic records of visible existing defects
  • Asset monitoring
  • Condition of surrounding area reporting

Before and after package

A combined pre- and post-works package across two site visits.

  • Pre-works dilapidation report
  • Drone imagery of relevant roof areas and HVAC equipment
  • Post-works photographic comparison
  • Digital report for project records and maintenance planning

Property inspections

In-person inspections of internal areas, plant and grounds for commercial and residential properties, with photo-based findings and clear recommendations.

Facilities management consultancy

Practical advice on building and facilities issues, with sourcing of suitable contractors and solutions.

Finding problems before they fail

A drone roof survey identified major roof issues before any failure occurred. We reported the defects and provided a solution, so the client could plan the repair instead of responding to an emergency.

That is the purpose of every inspection we complete: see the problem early, explain it clearly and give you a practical way forward.

How it works

Every job starts with a conversation, so the scope and price suit your site.

  1. Get in touch

    Tell us about the property, its size and what you need.

  2. Receive a quote

    We confirm the scope, price and timing for your site.

  3. Inspection

    We inspect the site using drone imaging and on-site assessment.

  4. Report and solutions

    You receive a detailed, photo-based report with recommended actions.
